slides.purpose: Define the project idea as an early-warning decision-support workflow.
visible_content: lead: EduGuard AI is an early-warning decision-support system for universities.
points: Identify students who may be academically at risk before the problem becomes severe.
points: Estimate dropout risk from information available by the end of Semester 1.
points: Give academic advisors an earlier, explainable basis for supportive intervention.
visible_content_ar: lead: EduGuard AI هو نظام لدعم القرار والإنذار المبكر في الجامعات.
points: التعرف على الطلاب الذين قد يواجهون خطرًا أكاديميًا قبل تفاقم المشكلة.
points: تقدير مخاطر الانسحاب باستخدام المعلومات المتاحة حتى نهاية الفصل الدراسي الأول.
points: تزويد المرشد الأكاديمي أساسًا مبكرًا وقابلًا للتفسير للتدخل الداعم.
visuals: Student information → Estimated risk → Advisor support flow.
oral_explanation_points: Explain why an early signal is useful before an outcome is known.
Connect the output to supportive advising.
supported_answers: The prediction point is the end of Semester 1.
The output is a calibrated estimated probability with a band, review flag, explanations, and recommendations.
warnings: Risk is not causality or certainty.

slides.purpose: Present the academic problem and research question.
visible_content: lead: Universities need a practical way to focus limited advising time on students who may need support first.
points: Struggling students may be identified only after important opportunities for support have passed.
points: Academic and financial indicators can provide an earlier warning signal.
points: Manual monitoring becomes difficult as the number of students grows.
points: Advisors need a data-driven support tool while retaining human judgment.
question: Can information available by the end of Semester 1 identify students at risk of dropout?
visible_content_ar: lead: تحتاج الجامعات إلى طريقة عملية لتركيز وقت الإرشاد المحدود على الطلاب الذين قد يحتاجون إلى الدعم أولًا.
points: قد يتم اكتشاف تعثر الطلاب بعد فوات فرص مهمة للدعم.
points: يمكن أن توفر المؤشرات الأكاديمية والمالية إنذارًا مبكرًا.
points: تصبح المتابعة اليدوية صعبة مع زيادة عدد الطلاب.
points: يحتاج المرشدون إلى أداة قائمة على البيانات مع الحفاظ على الحكم البشري.
question: هل يمكن استخدام المعلومات المتاحة حتى نهاية الفصل الدراسي الأول للتعرف على الطلاب المعرضين لخطر الانسحاب؟
visuals: Bullets and highlighted research-question callout.
oral_explanation_points: Explain why manual monitoring of a large cohort is difficult.
Read the research question exactly.
supported_answers: A large cohort makes consistent manual prioritization difficult; the system provides a repeatable aid while keeping human judgment.
warnings: Data does not replace the advisor.

slides.purpose: List the project objectives.
visible_content: lead: The project combines a validated machine-learning workflow with a usable advisor interface.
objectives: Build an early-warning machine-learning model.
objectives: Predict dropout risk using data available by Semester 1.
objectives: Prevent future-data leakage during model development.
objectives: Provide calibrated risk scores rather than an uncalibrated ranking only.
objectives: Explain individual predictions and generate advisor recommendations.
objectives: Deliver a web-based decision-support system for analysis and reporting.
visible_content_ar: lead: يجمع المشروع بين سير عمل موثوق لتعلم الآلة وواجهة عملية للمرشد الأكاديمي.
objectives: بناء نموذج تعلم آلة للإنذار المبكر.
objectives: توقع مخاطر الانسحاب باستخدام بيانات الفصل الدراسي الأول.
objectives: منع تسرب بيانات المستقبل أثناء التطوير.
objectives: تقديم درجات مخاطر معايرة بدلًا من ترتيب غير معاير فقط.
objectives: تفسير التنبؤات الفردية وتوليد توصيات للمرشد.
objectives: تقديم نظام ويب لدعم القرار والتحليل والتقارير.
visuals: Six numbered objective blocks.
oral_explanation_points: Explain leakage prevention and calibration as validity objectives.
Connect explainability and recommendations to advisor usability.
supported_answers: Leakage prevention protects evaluation credibility; explanations let advisors inspect influential inputs.
warnings: Objectives do not establish causality.

slides.purpose: Define the system boundary as decision support.
visible_content: lead: EduGuard supports academic review; it does not replace an academic decision-maker.
does_not: Prove that a factor caused dropout
visible_content_ar: lead: يدعم EduGuard المراجعة الأكاديمية ولا يحل محل صاحب القرار الأكاديمي.
does: تفسير المدخلات المؤثرة في النموذج
does_not: إثبات أن عاملًا ما تسبب في الانسحاب
visuals: Does/does-not panels and Decision Support System callout.
oral_explanation_points: Describe ranking and review as prioritization.
Emphasize no automatic expulsion or final decision.
supported_answers: No; it estimates risk and supports advisor review. No automatic punishment exists.
warnings: Never present it as autonomous disciplinary software.

slides.purpose: Describe the source cohort and original target categories.
visible_content: lead: The source contains demographic, admission, academic, financial and economic variables.
why: The dataset provides a documented higher-education context for evaluating an early-warning approach.
visible_content_ar: lead: تتضمن البيانات متغيرات ديموغرافية ومتغيرات القبول والأداء الأكاديمي والتمويل والاقتصاد.
why: توفر البيانات سياقًا موثقًا للتعليم العالي لتقييم منهج الإنذار المبكر.
visuals: Metric cards, outcome cards, source label, and dataset note.
methodology: Counts come from data/raw/data.csv; original input count is 36.
why_this_method: The source provides demographic, admission, academic, financial, and economic context.
oral_explanation_points: State 4,424 rows, 36 inputs, and three outcomes.
Explain UCI provenance without claiming UCI collected the data.
Differentiate original inputs from 30 operational features.
supported_answers: There are 4,424 students, 36 inputs, Graduate 2,209, Dropout 1,421, and Enrolled 794.
warnings: Do not call Enrolled a resolved negative label.

slides.purpose: Explain the binary training target and separate current-student scoring cohort.
visible_content: lead: The three original outcomes are separated into resolved training labels and a current-student scoring cohort.
note: Enrolled is excluded from supervised training because it is not a resolved final outcome. After training, Enrolled students are scored by the model.
why: This keeps the training target tied to outcomes that are known and resolved.
visible_content_ar: lead: يتم فصل الحالات النهائية الأصلية إلى تسميات تدريب محسومة ومجموعة طلاب حاليين للتقييم.
note: يُستبعد الطلاب المقيدون من التدريب الخاضع للإشراف لأن حالتهم ليست نتيجة نهائية محسومة. بعد التدريب، يقيّم النموذج الطلاب المقيدين.
why: يربط هذا الإجراء هدف التدريب بنتائج معروفة ومحسومة.
visuals: Graduate→0, Dropout→1, and Enrolled-not-training cards.
methodology: Training uses resolved Graduate/Dropout rows; Enrolled is scored after training.
why_this_method: Enrolled is unresolved, so relabeling it would invent an outcome.
oral_explanation_points: Mention 3,630 resolved and 794 Enrolled rows.
Clarify Student ID and name are not model features.
supported_answers: Enrolled has no final outcome at the prediction point; the trained binary model scores the current students.
warnings: Do not describe Enrolled as class 0 or a confirmed graduate.

slides.title_ar: تصميم الإنذار المبكر ومنع تسرب البيانات
slides.purpose: Show the end-of-Semester-1 prediction point and prevent future-data leakage.
visible_content: title: Early-warning design and data leakage
lead: The prediction point is the end of Semester 1.
note: Semester-2 variables contain future information relative to the decision point. Keeping them would make evaluation unrealistically strong.
why: Removing future information makes the early-warning experiment match the information available when an advisor would act.
visible_content_ar: title: تصميم الإنذار المبكر ومنع تسرب البيانات
lead: تحدث عملية التنبؤ في نهاية الفصل الدراسي الأول.
excluded: الوحدات المحتسبة في الفصل الثاني
excluded: الوحدات المسجلة في الفصل الثاني
excluded: الوحدات المجتازة في الفصل الثاني
excluded: وحدات الفصل الثاني دون تقييم
note: تحتوي متغيرات الفصل الثاني على معلومات مستقبلية بالنسبة إلى نقطة القرار. استخدامها يجعل التقييم قويًا بشكل غير واقعي.
why: استبعاد معلومات المستقبل يجعل التجربة مطابقة للمعلومات المتاحة عند اتخاذ قرار الدعم.
visuals: Allowed/excluded panels for Semester 1 and Semester 2.
methodology: Six Semester-2 columns are excluded: credited, enrolled, evaluations, approved, grade, and without evaluations.
why_this_method: Semester-2 values are future information and would make evaluation unrealistically strong.
oral_explanation_points: Name the prediction point.
Explain leakage.
State that six columns were removed, leaving 30 operational features.
supported_answers: Leakage uses information unavailable when an advisor would act; Semester 2 would no longer test an early-warning system.
warnings: Do not claim the operational model uses Semester-2 inputs.

slides.purpose: Document data-quality checks and preprocessing.
visible_content: lead: The validation workflow checks data quality before fitting any candidate model.
points: Categorical features are One-Hot Encoded.
points: Numeric missing values use median imputation.
points: Categorical missing values use most-frequent imputation.
why: A fixed preprocessing pipeline applies the same data preparation rules during training and inference.
visible_content_ar: lead: يتحقق سير العمل من جودة البيانات قبل تدريب أي نموذج مرشح.
pipeline: التحقق من القيم غير الصالحة
points: يتم ترميز الخصائص الفئوية باستخدام One-Hot Encoding.
points: تستخدم القيم الوسيطة لتعويض القيم الرقمية المفقودة.
points: تستخدم الفئة الأكثر تكرارًا لتعويض القيم الفئوية المفقودة.
why: يطبق خط معالجة ثابت قواعد التحضير نفسها أثناء التدريب والاستخدام.
visuals: Seven-node raw-data-to-scaling pipeline.
methodology: FINAL V2 reports zero missing values and zero duplicates before drop; categorical features are one-hot encoded and imputed by the pipeline.
why_this_method: A fixed pipeline applies the same rules during training and inference.
oral_explanation_points: Explain median and most-frequent imputation.
Explain one-hot encoding and validation.
supported_answers: Numeric values use median imputation and categorical values most-frequent imputation; the pipeline keeps transformations consistent.
warnings: Do not claim missingness was ignored.

slides.purpose: Explain why extreme values were inspected but not deleted blindly.
visible_content: lead: Outlier detection is used to inspect values, not to delete students mechanically.
points: IQR analysis identified many extreme observations.
points: Older students, unusual unit counts and extreme but valid grades can be legitimate records.
points: Impossible values are treated as missing and validated before modeling.
points: Valid extreme observations remain in the dataset.
methods: Tree models: original numeric scale
why: RobustScaler uses the median and IQR, so it is less affected by extreme values; tree models do not require scaling.
visible_content_ar: lead: يُستخدم اكتشاف القيم الشاذة لفحص البيانات، وليس لحذف الطلاب آليًا.
points: كشف تحليل IQR عن عدد كبير من القيم المتطرفة.
points: قد تكون أعمار بعض الطلاب أو أعداد الوحدات أو الدرجات المتطرفة صحيحة.
points: تُعامل القيم المستحيلة كقيم مفقودة وتخضع للتحقق.
points: تبقى الملاحظات المتطرفة الصحيحة في البيانات.
methods: نماذج الأشجار: المقياس الرقمي الأصلي
why: يستخدم RobustScaler الوسيط وIQR، لذلك يتأثر بدرجة أقل بالقيم المتطرفة؛ ولا تحتاج نماذج الأشجار إلى القياس.
visuals: Outlier bullets and RobustScaler/tree-model choices.
methodology: IQR detects unusual values; impossible values become missing; valid extremes remain. Logistic Regression uses RobustScaler; tree models keep numeric scale.
why_this_method: Median/IQR scaling is less sensitive to valid extremes, while tree splits do not require scaling.
oral_explanation_points: Give valid extreme examples.
Contrast RobustScaler with StandardScaler.
Explain why tree models do not need scaling.
likely_questions: Why not remove all IQR outliers?
supported_answers: IQR does not prove invalidity; only Logistic Regression uses RobustScaler in this design.
warnings: Do not say all IQR outliers were deleted.

slides.purpose: Describe class imbalance and handling.
visible_content: lead: The resolved outcomes are not perfectly balanced, so the training objective accounts for class frequency.
handling: class_weight for Logistic Regression, Random Forest and Extra Trees
why: Class weighting preserves real student records while giving the positive Dropout class appropriate influence.
smote: SMOTE was not required: class weighting was sufficient and avoids creating synthetic student records.
visible_content_ar: lead: النتائج المحسومة ليست متوازنة تمامًا، لذلك يراعي التدريب تكرار الفئات.
handling: class_weight للانحدار اللوجستي وRandom Forest وExtra Trees
why: يحافظ وزن الفئات على سجلات الطلاب الحقيقية ويمنح فئة الانسحاب تأثيرًا مناسبًا.
smote: لم تكن SMOTE مطلوبة؛ كان وزن الفئات كافيًا وتجنب إنشاء سجلات طلاب اصطناعية.
visuals: Graduate/Dropout cards, bars, class-weight chips, and SMOTE note.
methodology: Resolved counts are 2,209 Graduate and 1,421 Dropout; training counts are 1,413 and 910 with scale_pos_weight 1.5527472527472528.
why_this_method: Class weighting preserves real records and gives Dropout suitable influence; SMOTE was not required.
oral_explanation_points: Explain Dropout as the positive class.
Explain class_weight and scale_pos_weight.
Explain why synthetic records were avoided.
supported_answers: Class weighting was sufficient and avoids synthetic student records; scale_pos_weight weights the positive class.
warnings: Do not claim perfect balance or SMOTE usage.

slides.purpose: Compare four candidate classifiers and cross-validated PR-AUC.
visible_content: lead: Four complementary classifiers were compared with the same evaluation design.
model_notes: Gradient boosting model for tabular data
why: Comparing a linear baseline with three tree ensembles tests whether non-linear relationships improve early-warning performance.
visible_content_ar: lead: تمت مقارنة أربعة مصنفات متكاملة باستخدام تصميم التقييم نفسه.
model_notes: خط أساس بسيط قابل للتفسير
why: تختبر مقارنة خط أساس خطي مع ثلاثة نماذج أشجار ما إذا كانت العلاقات غير الخطية تحسن الإنذار المبكر.
visuals: Horizontal Chart.js chart and four model-note cards; XGBoost highlighted.
methodology: CV PR-AUC values come from final_v2_metrics.json.
why_this_method: The comparison covers an interpretable baseline and complementary tree ensembles for nonlinear tabular data.
oral_explanation_points: Explain the baseline.
Contrast ensemble families.
Point out evidence-based selection.
supported_answers: Logistic Regression is a transparent baseline; XGBoost is a strong tabular candidate and had the strongest CV PR-AUC in this run.
warnings: Do not say XGBoost is universally best.

slides.purpose: Explain five-fold Stratified CV, PR-AUC selection, and the train/CV gap.
visible_content: lead: Model selection uses five-fold Stratified Cross-Validation on the resolved training population.
points: Stratification preserves the Graduate/Dropout class distribution in each fold.
points: PR-AUC focuses on the positive Dropout class and is informative under class imbalance.
points: XGBoost achieved the strongest cross-validated PR-AUC and was selected.
note: There is a moderate Train-to-CV gap of approximately 5.9 percentage points, while validation and untouched test performance remain strong.
why: Stratified cross-validation preserves class proportions across folds; PR-AUC focuses evaluation on the positive Dropout class under class imbalance.
visible_content_ar: lead: استخدم اختيار النموذج تحققًا متقاطعًا طبقيًا من خمس طيات على مجموعة التدريب المحسومة.
points: يحافظ التقسيم الطبقي على توزيع فئتي التخرج والانسحاب في كل طية.
points: يركز PR-AUC على فئة الانسحاب الإيجابية ويُعد مناسبًا مع عدم توازن الفئات.
points: حقق XGBoost أقوى PR-AUC متقاطع وتم اختياره.
why: يقدر التحقق الطبقي التعميم مع الحفاظ على نسب الفئات؛ ويركز PR-AUC على الفئة التي تحتاج إلى دعم مبكر.
visuals: Selection cards, grouped train/CV chart, and rationale bullets.
methodology: Five-fold Stratified Cross-Validation; PR-AUC is primary selection metric; all four models are shown.
why_this_method: Stratification preserves class proportions; PR-AUC focuses Dropout; XGBoost had the strongest CV PR-AUC.
oral_explanation_points: Read Train 98.66%, CV 92.77%, gap 5.90 percentage points.
Use moderate-gap wording.
Explain strong untouched-test evidence.
supported_answers: PR-AUC focuses precision/recall for the positive class; the moderate gap is monitored while CV and test performance remain strong.
warnings: Do not call the gap negligible.

slides.purpose: Explain isotonic calibration, thresholds, and human review.
visible_content: lead: The selected model is calibrated so the displayed score is easier to interpret as estimated risk.
points: High-risk threshold: selected to meet a minimum target Recall of 85%.
points: Human-review margin: ±8 percentage points around the high-risk threshold.
why: Calibration improves the interpretation of probabilities; threshold tuning makes the early-warning system sensitive to the positive class.
visible_content_ar: lead: تمت معايرة النموذج المختار ليكون تفسير الدرجة المعروضة أقرب إلى المخاطر المقدّرة.
points: حد المخاطر المرتفعة: اختير لتحقيق حد أدنى للاستدعاء قدره 85٪.
points: هامش المراجعة البشرية: ±8 نقاط مئوية حول حد المخاطر المرتفعة.
why: تحسن المعايرة تفسير الاحتمالات؛ ويجعل ضبط العتبة النظام أكثر حساسية للفئة الإيجابية.
visuals: Isotonic label, threshold scale, cards, and bullets.
methodology: High threshold 0.48148149251937866; medium threshold 0.3; review margin 0.08.
why_this_method: Isotonic Regression makes scores more interpretable as estimated probabilities; high threshold tuning targeted minimum Recall 85%.
oral_explanation_points: Explain calibration as probability interpretation.
Explain bands and separate review margin.
supported_answers: It calibrates raw scores; threshold tuning targeted minimum Recall 85% and exported 0.48148149251937866.
warnings: 48.15% remains estimated risk, not certainty.

slides.purpose: Present final untouched-test metrics and emphasize Recall.
visible_content: lead: These values come from the untouched FINAL V2 test split after model selection and calibration.
why: Recall is emphasized because missing a student who may need support can be more costly than reviewing additional false-positive cases.
visible_content_ar: lead: تأتي هذه القيم من مجموعة اختبار FINAL V2 غير المستخدمة بعد اختيار النموذج والمعايرة.
why: يحظى الاستدعاء باهتمام خاص لأن تفويت طالب قد يحتاج إلى الدعم قد يكون أكثر تكلفة من مراجعة حالات إيجابية كاذبة إضافية.
visuals: Seven metric cards with Recall emphasized.
methodology: Values are from the untouched FINAL V2 test split after selection and calibration.
why_this_method: Missing an at-risk student can cost more than reviewing additional false positives.
oral_explanation_points: Read all metrics.
Explain Brier Score as probabilistic squared-error quality.
State these are test values.
supported_answers: Brier Score summarizes probability error; the executed value is 0.07753758132457733. Recall is central to early warning.
warnings: Do not present Brier as accuracy or claim perfection.

slides.purpose: Show confusion-matrix, ranking, calibration, and confidence-interval evidence.
visible_content: lead: The final test probabilities were evaluated with threshold, ranking and calibration views.
interpretation: The stored curves and intervals are derived from the executed FINAL V2 run; no curve points are invented for the presentation.
visible_content_ar: lead: تم تقييم احتمالات الاختبار النهائية باستخدام مصفوفة الالتباس ومنحنيات الترتيب والمعايرة.
interpretation: تم اشتقاق المنحنيات والفواصل المخزنة من تشغيل FINAL V2 الفعلي؛ ولم تتم إضافة نقاط منحنيات مختلقة.
visuals: Confusion cards, 95% CI rows, and stored ROC, PR, and calibration curves.
methodology: Charts use actual curve arrays in final_v2_metrics.json; no points are invented.
why_this_method: Multiple views separate classification errors, ranking quality, and probability reliability.
oral_explanation_points: Explain each matrix cell.
Explain ROC-AUC versus PR-AUC.
Explain confidence intervals.
likely_questions: How do ROC-AUC and PR-AUC differ?
supported_answers: The matrix is [[369, 73], [22, 262]]. ROC-AUC summarizes both classes; PR-AUC focuses the positive Dropout class.
warnings: AUC is not threshold-specific accuracy or causal evidence.

slides.purpose: Distinguish global feature importance from SHAP contribution.
visible_content: lead: Global importance and local contribution answer different questions about the model.
definitions: Global effect on model performance when a feature is shuffled.
definitions: Contribution of features to an individual or global prediction.
definitions: A model contribution does not prove causation.
features: Tuition fees up to date
why: Using both global and local explanations helps an advisor understand model behavior without presenting it as a causal finding.
visible_content_ar: lead: تجيب الأهمية العامة والمساهمة المحلية عن سؤالين مختلفين حول سلوك النموذج.
definitions: الأثر العام على أداء النموذج عند تبديل قيم الخاصية.
definitions: مساهمة الخصائص في تنبؤ فردي أو في النموذج عمومًا.
definitions: مساهمة النموذج لا تثبت علاقة سببية.
features: الوحدات المجتازة في الفصل الأول
features: الوحدات المسجلة في الفصل الأول
why: يساعد الجمع بين التفسير العام والمحلي المرشد على فهم سلوك النموذج دون عرضه كاكتشاف سببي.
visuals: Definition cards, top-five permutation bars, top-five SHAP bars, and feature note.
methodology: Permutation and SHAP summaries come from final_v2_metrics.json; Flask computes Tree SHAP for individual inputs.
why_this_method: The views show global sensitivity and contribution without causal claims.
oral_explanation_points: Explain shuffling for permutation importance.
Explain SHAP contribution.
Mention leading features and individual direction.
supported_answers: Permutation measures performance change after shuffling; SHAP attributes contribution. Neither proves causation.
warnings: Do not say a feature caused dropout.

slides.purpose: Report calibrated risk bands for the current Enrolled cohort.
visible_content: lead: The trained model scores the current Enrolled cohort after supervised training is complete.
note: The Medium-risk band exists, but no student in this scored cohort falls inside that calibrated probability interval. This is a cohort result, not a system error.
visible_content_ar: title: تقييم مخاطر الطلاب المقيدين حاليًا
lead: يقيّم النموذج المدرب مجموعة الطلاب المقيدين بعد اكتمال التدريب الخاضع للإشراف.
note: توجد فئة المخاطر المتوسطة في النظام، لكن لا يقع أي طالب في هذه المجموعة داخل مجال الاحتمال المعاير لها. هذه نتيجة للمجموعة وليست خطأ في النظام.
visuals: Four cards, risk bars, review count, and Medium=0 note.
